channel.description: New entries across the GitHub awesome ecosystem, diffed nightly.

item.title: DSA View View — via awesome-algorithms
item.description: Runs your own TypeScript algorithm functions in the browser and shows arrays, matrices, trees, linked lists, stacks, and pointers changing step by step, with built-in LeetCode-style examples.

item.title: leetcode-py — via awesome-algorithms
item.description: Generates local LeetCode practice environments in Python, with Graphviz diagrams of trees, linked lists, and graphs in Jupyter and a parametrized pytest suite per problem.
